topic: Front-End Engineering: React, React Native, and the craft of UI

modules.title: CSS & Layout Fundamentals (done right)
modules.summary: The mental models a backend dev actually needs. Box model reality, flexbox and grid deeply, modern CSS (custom properties, container queries, :has).

modules.title: React Deeply — Hooks, State, Rendering
modules.summary: What you missed teaching yourself React. The rendering model, useEffect as escape hatch (not a lifecycle), derived state, state colocation, and modern state libs (Zustand, TanStack Query).

exercises.title: Rendering Detective — spot the re-render bugs
State Refactor — fix a useEffect-soup component

modules.title: Component Patterns & Architecture
modules.summary: Composition over configuration, compound components, controlled vs uncontrolled, custom hooks as patterns, headless UI philosophy.

exercises.title: Build an Accessible Dialog From Scratch

modules.title: Design Taste & UI/UX Patterns
modules.summary: Typography, color (OKLCH), spacing scales, visual hierarchy, micro-interactions, common dashboard patterns. Built when you reach this module.

modules.title: Accessibility as a First-Class Concern
modules.summary: Semantic HTML, ARIA (when needed, when not), keyboard nav, focus management, screen reader testing, contrast, reduced motion. Built when you reach this module.

modules.title: Theming & Component Libraries
modules.summary: Tailwind philosophy, shadcn/ui, design tokens architecture, dark mode done right. Built when you reach this module.

modules.title: Data Visualization
modules.summary: Recharts, Visx, D3 fundamentals, Observable Plot, non-standard charts (sankey, radial, bump, calendar heatmaps). Built when you reach this module — this is the most exciting one given your capstone.

modules.title: React Native for Mobile
modules.summary: The mental model shift, Expo, navigation, gestures, Reanimated, platform patterns. Built when you reach this module.

capstone.title: Analytics Dashboard — the thread through every module
capstone.description: By the end, you will have built a production-quality analytics dashboard: dataset management, a chart library with standard and non-standard visualizations, a design system with light/dark themes, fully accessible keyboard nav and screen reader support, and a React Native companion. Each module contributes a piece.

pieces_by_module.module-07: Chart library — Recharts, Visx, custom D3
